content_html:
Watched #LootCase : a good time pass for your weekend. Nothing Much about story or other technical aspects. But the whole bunch of talented actors : Kunal Khemu, Rasika Dugal, Vijay Raaz, Ranvir Shorey & Gajraj Rao ensured they provide good entertainment. Special mention of Vijay Raaz and Gajraj Rao who entertain us in their Villan Avatar _/\_

if you wqnt to kill time by watching a decent comedy movie, then go for it will not dissapoint you. Apart from that dont expect anything much from this.
